why: The capture ran at TP2/EP2 because vLLM refuses --enable-eplb below tensor_parallel_size * data_parallel_size > 1 (vllm/config/parallel.py:467), and EPLB is the only emitter of the machine-readable routing record (vllm/distributed/eplb/eplb_state.py:582). The simulated arch qwen36_local is TP1/EP1, so simulator/src/arch/build.rs:359 rejects the captured ep_size. counts_by_layer[layer][logical_expert] is logical demand AFTER physical->logical remapping and EP-group reduction, i.e. before EP placement, and which experts a token selects depends on its hidden state rather than on sharding -- so the tensor is topology-invariant and is reused unchanged. Only the partition metadata is restated for the EP=1 consumer.
do_not_use_for: Per-step temporal structure. TP2 batches differently, so the eplb_step series is NOT the TP1 iteration series. This artifact is aggregate demand only, and it is not timing evidence of any kind.
